candidate.definition_en: Feeling or causing despair; having no expectation of success.
candidate.explanation_ar: فاقد الأمل، أو حالة ميئوس منها ومفيش فايدة فيها.

senses.definition_en: Feeling no hope or despairing about a situation.
examples: He felt hopeless about the future.

senses.definition_en: Giving no reason to expect good results or success; impossible to solve.
senses.explanation_ar: ميئوس منه ولا أمل في تحسنه أو نجاحه.
examples: She gave a hopeless shrug of her shoulders.
He felt hopeless about the future.
She gave a hopeless shrug of her shoulders.
